http/internal/http2_receiving#

The receive side of HTTP/2 flow control: the connection window, the bodies of open streams, and the credit returned as they are read.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The receive side of HTTP/2 flow control: the connection window, the bodies of open streams, and the credit returned as they are read.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object Http2ReceiveFlow#

object Http2ReceiveFlow does Http2BodyEvents

Connection-level receive ledger. Native body owners are deliberately borrowed: the owning session retains them in supervised stream lifetimes.

A ledger queuing WINDOW_UPDATEs on controls, with maximum streams.

Http2ReceiveFlow.observed_closed#

observed_closed(stream is int) is void

A server can reject decoded request fields before allocating a body. Remember only the increasing boundary, so late DATA still spends and returns connection credit without allocating a tombstone per stream.
